requirements.text: An inbound /boon-chat turn for an internal-test (@getboon.ai) sender results in the LLM gateway receiving X-Boon-Gateway-Obo-Token, verifying it (tier-1), skipping the customer token meter with a signed source, and reporting usage back to boon-core — end to end, observed locally.
requirements.closed_by: acceptance A1 red→green (local gateway log flips from 'no OBO header' / silence to 'obo verified' + signed-source meter skip)

tasks.text: openclaw: the PRIMARY-turn embedded runner params carry run.oboToken (agent-runner-utils buildTemplateSenderContext). #185 fixed the read (ctx not sessionCtx); #190 fixed the QUEUED-followup hop; the first turn goes through agent-runner-execution → buildEmbeddedRunExecutionParams, which builds identity from persisted sessionCtx only and never saw run.oboToken.

dead_aliases: obo_token (the READ token — different audience, do not confuse)

glossary.product: Boon staff testing in a customer workspace
glossary.code: internal_test claim; gateway tier-1 (signed OBO) / tier-2 (getboon_email X-Boon-User-ID)

boon-core.role: mints OBO (Ed25519, aud boon-llm-gateway-usage-meter, 5-min TTL) per dispatch; serves pubkeys; receives usage

openclaw.role: orchestrator: threads per-turn identity into the model call headers

boon-llm-gateway.role: verifies OBO fail-closed; decides tier; meters
boon-llm-gateway.relationship_to_openclaw: published header contract X-Boon-Gateway-Obo-Token — provider-side, additive

orchestrators: openclaw get-reply-run → agent-runner-execution → embedded runner (sequences identity into headers; owns no rule)

A1.how: send one chat message as the org-2 @getboon.ai user in local boon web (localhost:3000); then grep local boon-llm-gateway stdout for the turn
A1.green: log contains 'obo verified' (or equivalent tier-1 success) for auth_org 2 AND a '[usage] internal-test: customer meter skipped' line whose source != getboon_email
A1.red_now: no such lines: either 'internal-test via tier-2 email; no OBO header on request' or only access-log lines

A4.green: GET /api/internal/openclaw_signing_keys… 200 for org 2 during the turn
